229b19ec: ;If DG is undefined or has a value less than or equal to 9, the code skips the following line(s) and goes to the next line of code. If DG is defined and has a value greater than 9, it calls the routine ^DIE17 with the F entry point and sets the variable DE. It then sets Y to the value of the U variable, DQ to 4, and calls the X4 tag within the current routine. If Y is undefined or has a value of U, it goes to the A tag within the current routine. If Y has a value other than U, it sets X to the value of Y, sets DIC(0) to the string 'F', and sets DW to the value of DQ. Finally, it goes to the OUT^DIE17 tag, which is likely an entry point in the DIE17 routine.
